_comment: Map Claude/Grok-compatible hook events to scripts copied under ~/.grok/hooks/cpc-toolbelt/. Adjust paths for your Grok Build hooks schema.

mappingNotes.SessionStart: Cursor equivalent: sessionStart — emits additional_context / additionalContext + env
mappingNotes.UserPromptSubmit: Cursor equivalent: beforeSubmitPrompt — soft cache-first context
mappingNotes.Stop: Cursor equivalent: stop — doctor nudge only if CPC_TOOLBELT_DOCTOR_ON_STOP=1
mappingNotes.noVolumes: These Toolbelt hooks do not depend on CPC_VOLUMES / autonomous Volumes
